name: MsgEthereumTx

fields.name: data
fields.comment: data is inner transaction data of the Ethereum transaction

fields.name: size
fields.comment: size is the encoded storage size of the transaction (DEPRECATED)

fields.name: hash
fields.comment: hash of the transaction in hex format

fields.name: from
fields.comment:
from is the ethereum signer address in hex format. This address value is checked
 against the address derived from the signature (V, R, S) using the
 secp256k1 elliptic curve

comment: MsgEthereumTx encapsulates an Ethereum transaction as an SDK message.

name: MsgUpdateParams

fields.name: authority
fields.comment: authority is the address of the governance account.

fields.name: params
fields.comment:
params defines the x/evm parameters to update.
 NOTE: All parameters must be supplied.

comment: MsgUpdateParams defines a Msg for updating the x/evm module parameters.

name: MsgUpdateParams

fields.name: authority

comment: MsgUpdateParams defines a Msg for updating the x/feemarket module parameters.

name: MsgConvertERC20

fields.name: contract_address
fields.comment: contract_address of an ERC20 token contract, that is registered in a token pair

fields.name: amount
fields.comment: amount of ERC20 tokens to convert

fields.name: receiver
fields.comment: receiver is the bech32 address to receive native Cosmos coins

fields.name: sender
fields.comment: sender is the hex address from the owner of the given ERC20 tokens

comment:
MsgConvertERC20 defines a Msg to convert a ERC20 token to a native Cosmos
 coin.

name: MsgCreateClawbackVestingAccount

fields.name: funder_address
fields.comment: funder_address specifies the account that will be able to fund the vesting account

fields.name: vesting_address
fields.comment: vesting_address specifies the address that will receive the vesting tokens

fields.name: enable_gov_clawback
fields.comment: enable_gov_clawback specifies whether the governance module can clawback this account

comment:
MsgCreateClawbackVestingAccount defines a message that enables creating a
 ClawbackVestingAccount.

name: MsgFundVestingAccount

fields.name: funder_address
fields.comment: funder_address specifies the account that funds the vesting account

fields.name: vesting_address
fields.comment: vesting_address specifies the account that receives the funds

fields.name: start_time
fields.comment: start_time defines the time at which the vesting period begins

fields.name: lockup_periods
fields.comment: lockup_periods defines the unlocking schedule relative to the start_time

fields.name: vesting_periods
fields.comment: vesting_periods defines the vesting schedule relative to the start_time

comment:
MsgFundVestingAccount defines a message that enables funding an existing clawback
 vesting account.

name: MsgClawback

fields.name: funder_address
fields.comment: funder_address is the address which funded the account

fields.name: account_address
fields.comment:
account_address is the address of the ClawbackVestingAccount to claw back
 from.

fields.name: dest_address
fields.comment:
dest_address specifies where the clawed-back tokens should be transferred
 to. If empty, the tokens will be transferred back to the original funder of
 the account.

comment:
MsgClawback defines a message that removes unvested tokens from a
 ClawbackVestingAccount.

name: MsgUpdateVestingFunder

fields.name: funder_address
fields.comment: funder_address is the current funder address of the ClawbackVestingAccount

fields.name: new_funder_address
fields.comment: new_funder_address is the new address to replace the existing funder_address

fields.name: vesting_address
fields.comment: vesting_address is the address of the ClawbackVestingAccount being updated

comment:
MsgUpdateVestingFunder defines a message that updates the funder account of a
 ClawbackVestingAccount.

name: MsgConvertVestingAccount

fields.name: vesting_address
fields.comment: vesting_address is the address of the vesting account to convert

comment: MsgConvertVestingAccount defines a message that enables converting a vesting account to an eth account
